Let me think about this year the way I always do.

My 6.5 mu — I split it like I always have. About 5 mu for wheat-maize rotation (winter wheat, then summer maize right after the wheat harvest in June), and 1.5 mu for cotton. Cotton takes the whole warm season so it cannot share land with maize.

Money is tight with just me and my old husband at home. Our son sends some money but we pay for everything on the farm ourselves. Fertilizer price went up again this year — last year compound fertilizer (15-15-15) was around 130 yuan a bag, urea around 100 yuan a bag. I watch what neighbors do. Most people around here put 2 bags of compound fertilizer before planting wheat and then urea in the spring after the wheat turns green. That is what I do too. I do not like to change — change can lose you the harvest.

**Wheat (winter, 5 mu):** I plow the land with a hired tractor, then use a seed drill. About 15 kg seed per mu — I buy improved seed from the agro-shop in town, the kind the dealer says everyone is using. Base fertilizer: 2 bags compound (15-15-15) per mu — that is 100 kg, giving me about 15 kg each of N, P, K. In spring I broadcast about 20 kg urea per mu before the second irrigation — that is another ~9 kg N. I water 3 times: before winter, returning green in March, and at grain filling. If the sky is dry I add a fourth. One pesticide spray for aphids, one for the head — so 2 sprays.

**Summer maize (5 mu):** After wheat I do not plow, I just sow maize straight into the stubble — saves money and time. One bag of compound per mu at planting, then at big trumpet stage I side-dress 25 kg urea per mu. I water once or twice depending on rain. Spray for armyworm and maize borer, maybe 2 times.

**Cotton (1.5 mu):** Cotton is more work and more spending. I plow it in spring, use improved cotton seed. Base: 40 kg compound per mu, then 20 kg urea per mu when bolls set. I also put a little potash, maybe 10 kg per mu, because cotton needs it for the bolls. I water 2-3 times. Cotton bugs are the problem — I spray 6 times through the season. Yield maybe 250 kg seed cotton per mu, depends on the weather in August.

I always put a little extra fertilizer rather than too little. A bad harvest means no income. Wasting some fertilizer only wastes money, but losing the crop is a real loss.
